assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road red lines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: The submitted SITE_BOUNDARY and three KEY_AREA polygons are provisional constraints (official_boundary=false). They are for generation, display and intake self-check only and must not be used as official red lines, approval basis or precise-area basis.
assumptions.impact: All area and ratio metrics must be recalculated when official boundary and key-area polygons are released; content scoring is not blocked by this organizer data gap.

assumptions.statement: Existing-building survey, ownership, floor-area ratio, height, density and setback data are not included in the cleared site package; building footprints are representative concept footprints, not an existing-building survey.
assumptions.impact: The retain-renovate-demolish list, building scale and development-intensity indicators are conceptual and must be deepened with professional data.

assumptions.statement: All annual events, developer-community operations, scenario open operations, recruitment, funding and policy arrangements are conceptual recommendations for professional teams to deepen, not confirmed government arrangements.
assumptions.impact: No implementation or investment commitment is implied; operational mechanisms require operator and institutional confirmation.
